title: DASH no longer shows the "silence alert" button to disable pod's alerting beeps
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.3.3.0-dev**
**Build**: 4d18c1a2
**Flavor**: Fullrelease

When the DASH pod is alerting (_expiration reminder, shutdown, low reservoir_) a button should appear on the DASH tab för user to "silence" the Pod beeps. This button is no longer enabled (made visible). See WiKi [Silencing Pod Alerts](https://wiki.aaps.app/en/latest/CompatiblePumps/OmnipodDASH.html#silencing-pod-alerts)

**Problem description:**
The "Silence Alerts" button on DASH tab is not visible on when Pod is alerting (even after refreshing state).
User can not silence Pod beeping every X minutes.

**Additional information**
Noticed this problem also on [build commit 40068c81ffd5bff07c98763f84cee95f5cb78acc](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commits/dev/) but the problem may also be on earlier commits.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1743700440381.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19594719/AndroidAPS_LOG_1743700440381.log.zip)
